ModMetaData.name: Animals Naturally - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Nelim's Animals, Naturally, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios only read the def database, the patch attribution, the load order and the log, so they change nothing in the game and need no save. A scenario whose optional mod is not in the modlist is skipped by its @requires tag.
